related_questions.question: Can glycopyrrolate treat bradycardia?
related_questions.snippet: Glycopyrrolate is a muscarinic receptor antagonist and an essential anticholinergic agent in perioperative care and various medical settings. Clinicians use this medication to inhibit salivary and respiratory secretions, achieve antisialagogue effects, and prevent reflex bradycardia during surgical procedures.
